summary: Sprint 1 monetizzazione — new affiliate stats endpoint + 2 new placements (filaments_low_stock, dashboard) + widget & page integrations. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (100%) covering auth gating on /admin/affiliate-links/stats, response contract (days/daily/top/total_clicks_period/total_clicks_all_time), days clamping (1..90, negative and >90), new placements return 200, invalid still 400, and full E2E: create link with placement=filaments_low_stock → visible in public listing → NOT visible in dashboard placement → click tracked → aggregated into stats top+total_clicks_period. Frontend: admin login OK, Affiliati tab → data-testid=affiliate-stats renders with chart + top list, aff-stats-days-7/14/30 selectors switch periods (network re-fetch verified), Nuovo Link form shows all 6 placement chips with data-testid=aff-placement-{guida,shop_footer,calculator,demo,filaments_low_stock,dashboard}. FilamentsPage renders low-stock-alert (existing PLA Nero -40g scorta) with ZERO pageerrors/console errors; AffiliateLinks component correctly returns null since no link is configured for filaments_low_stock (expected per requirement). DashboardPage renders with data-testid=dashboard-page and ZERO pageerrors/console errors.

issues: Top link cliccati card shows 'Ordinati per click totali (all-time: 8)' in the subtitle but the body says 'Nessun click ancora registrato' when no items have clicks_period > 0. The empty-state condition seems tied to period rather than all-time count → looks contradictory. Consider showing the top list ordered by clicks_total even when clicks_period is 0, or align both messages.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Fix subtle inconsistency in AffiliateStatsCard 'Top link' empty state: title advertises 'all-time: N' but body renders empty when clicks_period == 0 for every top item.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_affiliate_stats: total_clicks_all_time is computed as sum of clicks_total in top-10 only (line 3262). If more than 10 links exist, the reported 'all-time' figure is under-counted. Should be a separate aggregation over ALL affiliate_links documents.

server.py admin_affiliate_stats: days query param is untyped (no Pydantic validation). Passing e.g. days=abc will raise 500 (int(days) inside the function receives a string from query which FastAPI would coerce, but a non-int like 'abc' would 422 at parse. Consider explicit Query(default=7, ge=1, le=90) for clarity and consistent 422s).

AdminPanelPage.js is 2394 lines (up from 2219) — file continues to grow past the 700-line guideline. Extracting AffiliateStatsCard + AffiliateLinksTab into a separate module would help maintainability.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_-prefixed affiliate links created during pytest E2E are deleted in try/finally teardown. No residual test data. Existing PLA Nero (-40g) low-stock filament is pre-existing seed and left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 1 features are functional and regression-clean. Backend stats endpoint + new placements verified end-to-end. Frontend widget, day selectors and 6-chip placement grid verified. FilamentsPage/DashboardPage render clean with no errors even when no affiliate link is configured for the corresponding placement (AffiliateLinks returns null as designed). If future work adds a UI for viewing all-time top links across ALL affiliate_links (not just top-10), verify total_clicks_all_time value on server.py:3262 is computed against the full collection.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 11 backend tests pass, all frontend interactive elements present and functional, zero console/pageerrors on Filaments and Dashboard pages.
